title: Ulyana and the Postcards
author: Xanthe Ravensworth
blurb: Freya Brightwater, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
